stem: The value of $\displaystyle\int_0^1 x^3 e^x\,dx$ is

verdicts.working: An antiderivative is $e^x(x^3-3x^2+6x-6)$. Evaluating from 0 to 1 gives $-2e-(-6)=6-2e$.

working:
$\int x^3e^x\,dx=e^x(x^3-3x^2+6x-6)$; $[e^x(x^3-3x^2+6x-6)]_0^1=-2e-(-6)=6-2e$.

Independent check: An antiderivative is $e^x(x^3-3x^2+6x-6)$. Evaluating from 0 to 1 gives $-2e-(-6)=6-2e$.
solution:
Using integration by parts repeatedly, an antiderivative is $e^x(x^3-3x^2+6x-6)$. Thus,
$$\int_0^1 x^3e^x\,dx=[e^x(x^3-3x^2+6x-6)]_0^1=6-2e.$$
